instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the palette rules: Primary Blue #203c89, Dark Blue #16295e, Light Blue #eef2fc, Pale Blue Border #dde4f4, Background #f4f6fc, Primary Action Orange #ee731f, Dark Orange #d45f11, Light Orange #fdefe3, Surface White #ffffff, Black titles #000000, Secondary #4d5670, Muted #7b849c.
Do NOT add forbidden colors such as purple, teal, pink, bright green, or full-screen gradients.
Ensure Poppins font is loaded for headings and Inter for body text.
Use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, wizard steps).
Maintain all existing backend endpoints and functionality intact without introducing mock data when real data exists.
Ensure total mobile responsiveness with sticky search access and collapsible secondary menu in PublicLayout header.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use transparent background in sticky header - use solid white (#ffffff) or white with subtle shadow and border #dde4f4.
All cards must have white background (#ffffff), pale blue border (#dde4f4), rounded-xl corners, and subtle hover transition.
Never use AI emoji characters for icons; use Lucide React icons.
Keep standard WCAG AA contrast for text over white and blue surfaces.
